about.text: Beaufort is a firm, raw cow's milk cheese associated with the gruyère family. An Alpine cheese, it is produced in Beaufortain, Tarentaise valley and Maurienne, which are located in the Savoie region of the French Alps.

how.label: press in a hoop
how.text: Ripening in a cold cellar keeps the paste supple and almost free of holes, unlike the eyed alpine cheeses. The wooden Beaufort hoop pressed around the cloth-wrapped curd gives the wheel its concave heel.
